name: theme-provider
goal: Create a ThemeProvider React context that manages dark/light mode, persists preference to localStorage, respects OS prefers-color-scheme, and sets data-theme on <html>
design_constraints: Cook confirms unit-test and quality-gate choices before each phase
Provider must be a client component wrapping the root layout
Persist user preference to localStorage key 'pte-practice-theme'
Default to system preference via matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)')
Expose useTheme() hook returning { theme, setTheme, toggleTheme }
No flash-of-wrong-theme: inject a blocking <script> in layout.tsx to set data-theme before React hydrates

steps.description: Create common/providers/ThemeProvider.tsx: a 'use client' React context that reads initial theme from localStorage (key 'pte-practice-theme') or falls back to matchMedia prefers-color-scheme. Sets data-theme attribute on document.documentElement. Exports ThemeProvider component and useTheme() hook with { theme: 'dark'|'light', setTheme, toggleTheme }.
success_criteria: Theme is persisted to localStorage on change
data-theme attribute is set on document.documentElement

steps.description: Create common/providers/theme-init.ts: export a THEME_INIT_SCRIPT constant (string of inline JS) that reads localStorage and matchMedia before React hydration and sets data-theme on <html>. This prevents flash-of-wrong-theme.
success_criteria: theme-init.ts exports a self-executing JS string that can be injected via <script dangerouslySetInnerHTML>
Script reads 'pte-practice-theme' from localStorage, falls back to prefers-color-scheme, sets data-theme attribute

steps.description: Update app/layout.tsx: remove hardcoded className='dark' from <html>. Add the blocking <script dangerouslySetInnerHTML> with THEME_INIT_SCRIPT. Wrap {children} with ThemeProvider.
success_criteria: <html> element no longer has hardcoded className='dark'
Blocking script tag is present before <body>
ThemeProvider wraps children in the layout

steps.description: Add a theme toggle button to the StudentShell side-rail (near the account-card area). Use AppIcon with 'sun'/'moon' icon and wire it to useTheme().toggleTheme. Add sun/moon SVG icons to AppIcon.tsx if not already present.
success_criteria: Theme toggle button is rendered in the side-rail
Clicking the toggle switches data-theme between dark and light
